evals.name: default-cross-review-of-working-tree
evals.prompt: before i commit this can you get codex to have a proper go at it? dont fix anything yet just tell me what it finds
assertions: Runs the xreview CLI with --json rather than composing a codex exec or claude -p command by hand
Relies on the default target and reviewer, or passes --reviewer codex, without narrowing the review to git diff HEAD
Runs it in the background or with a timeout of 10 minutes or more
Opens the cited code for each finding and labels it confirmed, disputed or needs-you, keeping the reviewer's severity and confidence verbatim
Leads the report with the verdict and triage counts and applies no fixes
evals.history: Replaces cross-review, whose hand-built claude -p --permission-mode plan call was shown to write to the repo under the user's allowlist.

evals.name: plan-review-before-execution
evals.prompt:
here's my plan for the migration (pasted below). get the other model to tear it apart before i start - check it against the actual repo

1. Rename users.email to users.primary_email
2. Update the ORM model
3. Deploy
assertions: Writes the plan to a file or pipes it on stdin and runs xreview --target plan:<file|-> from inside the repository
Does not substitute a code review of the working tree for the plan review
Checks each finding's claims about the codebase against the repository before labelling it
Reports needs-you for trade-offs such as downtime or backfill strategy rather than deciding them
Does not start executing the plan
evals.history: Plan review is a first-class target so a reviewer can check the plan's assumptions against the code before any change exists.

evals.name: pr-review-with-rubric-and-post
evals.prompt: review PR 42 with a panel using the thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review rubric and leave the comments on the PR for me to look at
assertions: Does not paraphrase the rubric or load it into --focus
Does not pass --model with the panel
Tells the user the GitHub review is pending, invisible to others until they submit it, and does not submit it
Names any reviewer listed in errors[] as missing from the panel rather than hiding the failure
evals.history: Exercises the outward-facing path: --post must stay a pending review the user submits.

how_to_run: Run each prompt with the skill and without it in fresh sessions, with the xreview CLI stubbed or pointed at a scratch repository. Never let an eval post to a real PR: stub gh, or stop before the xreview call for eval 3 and grade the command. Grade the transcript against the assertions.
notes: The baseline without the skill hand-builds reviewer commands (often claude -p --permission-mode plan, which is not read-only headless), reviews git diff HEAD and misses untracked files, and relays reviewer output as fact without checking it against the code. Those are the behavioural targets.
